name: Studio 2201: Sonar (8-Bit Corner Speakers)
description: Dual bottom-left and bottom-right 8-bit triangular corner audio spectrum visualizers for GNOME Shell 45–50. Driven by real-time in-process GStreamer stereo (L/R) PipeWire/PulseAudio monitor analysis with 8-bit pixel LED bricks, peak-hold caps, MPRIS media & volume scroll controls, and Studio 2201 suite color sync.
